title: HRMS Software Cost in India
seoTitle: HRMS and Payroll Software Cost in India (2026)
seoDescription: What custom HRMS and payroll software costs in India: attendance, leave, payroll with PF/ESI/TDS, employee app. Cost bands, timelines and when to build.
summary: Custom HRMS software in India typically costs ₹5 lakh to ₹12 lakh for attendance, leave and employee records, ₹12 lakh to ₹25 lakh with payroll including PF, ESI and TDS, shift rosters and an employee app, and more for multi-entity groups. Many businesses are better served by payroll SaaS unless their rules are unusual.

body:
## Build or subscribe

Indian payroll SaaS handles statutory compliance well for standard set-ups. Custom HRMS makes sense for large blue-collar or contract workforces, complex shifts, or deep integration with operations. See [HRMS: when a custom build makes sense](/blog/hrms-when-a-custom-build-makes-sense).

These ranges are indicative for 2026, based on the effort such projects typically take. Your quote depends on your scope, integrations and quality requirements; a short discovery phase turns this into a firm number.

faqs.a: Yes, with geofenced check-in and selfie verification, alongside or instead of biometric devices.
